title: Wearable armour pieces in the Blender pipeline (per armour set)
player_outcome: No direct change yet. Every armour set gets real wearable pieces (helmet, breastplate, pauldrons, bracers, belt, greaves, boots) in its own style, and the inventory icons show what you'll actually wear.
design: Verified: the helmet/chest_armor/greaves generators are icon props (122/156/92 tris); nothing is wearable (items.py:172-190). There are 32 armour sets plus mining_helmet and wizard_hat.
New bgen/armor.py: rigid pieces authored in bone-local space of the shared human frame (frame_mod.Frame with default player params): head, chest, pauldron.L/R, bracer.L/R, belt, greave.L/R, boot.L/R.

Helmet styles: dome, full_helm (visor), hood, wizard cone, mask, horned/beetle, mining (lamp, prop:plain:glow). Chest styles: plate, chain, robe, carapace, scale, cloth. Uses prop layers (silver/copper/gold, cloth, leather, plain:glow) plus tints.
assets.json 'armor': {key: {head: {style, params}, body: {...}, legs: {...}}}. Keys are armorSet ids plus single items (mining_helmet, wizard_hat). The metal sets default from metalStyles/metals.

build_all.py builds assets/models/armor/<key>_<piece>.glb and records manifest 'armor' {key: {piece: {model, bone, refLength, hidesHair}}}. Move plan() into a new bgen/plan.py if build_all.py nears 400 lines.
Armour item icons render from the worn pieces (head piece for helmets; chest+pauldrons for body; greaves+boots for legs), replacing the old generators for set items.
Core AssetPaths.ArmorPiece(key, piece). ContentValidator warns when an armour item has no pieces in the manifest (warning until built).
files_add: tools/blender/bgen/plan.py — build planning (if needed for the line cap)
data_changes: assets.json armor entries for 32 sets + 2 singles (styles: copper/tin plain helm; iron/lead chain; silver/tungsten; gold/platinum ornate; demonite/crimtane scale; meteor space helm with glow visor; molten (hellstone) horned plate with glow; jungle leaf; necro bone; bee; cobalt..titanium; hallowed; chlorophyte; turtle; beetle; spectre hood; shroomite; solar/vortex/nebula/stardust with glow)
tests: python3 tools/blender/build_all.py --check (every armour item has an entry)
verification: preview.py: a new 'armor on player' preview (player mesh + pieces parented to bones) contact sheet per set
risks: Male vs female and height variants: pieces are rigid and scaled at runtime per bone length (P3-42); check fit on m_* and f_* rigs.
Large asset growth (~34 × 10 GLBs); keep tris in budget.
